==English==

===Etymology===
{{ety|en|:lbor|la:sēlēctus|tree=1}}
From {{uder|en|la|sēlēctus}}, perfect passive participle of {{m|la|sēligō||choose out, select}}, from {{m|la|sē-||without; apart}} + {{m|la|legō||gather, select}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/sɪˈlɛkt/|/səˈlɛkt/}}
* {{audio|en|LL-Q1860 (eng)-Vealhurl-select.wav|a=Southern England}}
* {{rhymes|en|ɛkt|s=2}}
* {{hyph|en|se|lect}}

===Adjective===
{{en-adj}}

# [[privileged|Privileged]], specially [[selected]].
#: {{ux|en|Only a '''select''' few were allowed into the premiere.}}
#: {{ux|en|The child was upset when he was cut from '''select''' soccer and had to play on his school team with the rest of the plebes.}}
#* {{RQ:Macaulay History of England|chapter=20|passage=A few '''select''' spirits had separated from the crowd, and formed a fit audience round a far greater teacher.}}
#* {{RQ:Besant Ivory Gate|III
|passage=At half-past nine on this Saturday evening, the parlour of the Salutation Inn, High Holborn, contained most of its customary visitors.{{...}}In former days every tavern of repute kept such a room for its own '''select''' circle, a club, or society, of habitués, who met every evening, for a pipe and a cheerful glass.}}
# Of [[high]] [[quality]]; [[top-notch]].
#: {{ux|en|This is a '''select''' cut of beef.}}
#* {{RQ:Lawrence Lady Chatterley's Lover|7|passage=The two sisters at once called on Mrs. Bolton, in a newish house in a row, quite '''select''' for Tevershall.}}

===Verb===
{{en-verb}}

# To [[choose]] one or more [[element]]s of a [[set]], ''especially'' a set of [[option]]s.
#: {{ux|en|He looked over the menu, and '''selected''' the roast beef.}}
#: {{ux|en|The program computes all the students' grades, then '''selects''' a random sample for human verification.}}
# {{lb|en|databases}} To obtain a set of data from a database using a [[query]].
